capabilities.name: Code Review
capabilities.description: Peer review of Source Code changes before merge.

items.statement: Choose easy to understand and short names for variables and functions.
Try using closures and the module pattern.
Use linting to verify your code.
Comment what you consider needed (`/* */` is much safer to use because it doesn’t cause errors when the line break is removed.).
Use Shortcut Notations.
Write smaller, generic helper functions that fulfill one specific task rather than catch-all methods.
Avoid heavy nesting.
Keep computation-heavy code outside of loops.
Keep DOM Access to a Minimum.
Don’t trust that data reaches your function is of the right format.Test with `typeof` and then do something with it.
Don’t expect elements in the DOM to be available.Test for them and that they indeed are what you expect them to be before altering them.
Never ever use JavaScript to protect something.
Use single quotation marks for string declarations.
Keep indentation as 2.
No js inline code has to be present in html.
Collate, minify and optimize your code in a build process.
JavaScript files are loaded asynchronously using async or deferred using defer attribute.
Use of if, if else, else if, switch should be used properly. Avoid too many nested if else statements, instead go for switch-case.
const and let should be used based on their definition.
Functions should hardly ever be 20 - 40 lines long.
Add parameter description for every function parameter as a part of comments.
Proper use of HOF (Higher order functions.).
Every method/function should have a try-catch block to avoid run time errors.
Use loggers in the catch block to get exact error.
Verify if business logic is proper and written efficiently.
Function casing.
Using spread operator.
Be consistent in your usage of arrow function.
Use destructuring assignment for arrays and objects.
Variable casing.
Use Promises or Async/Await. Rejection is handled.
No syntax/runtime errors and warnings in the code.
No deprecated functions in the code.
Check that each function is doing only a single thing.
No magic numbers. Put all such numbers as a constant.
Make sure recursive function don’t end up in infinite loop.
Avoid inline styling through JS use classes instead.
make sure the whole script wrapped inside document ready.
Use meaningful names for variables and function.
Add proper commenting.
Try using deffer while loading Scripts to avoid render blocking resources issue in the performance.
Make sure there is no message/error present in the console.
Please make sure to use condition while using offset().top property if the offset is present then only use top or else it will throw an error in the console.
Form/Input validation is not just to add required attribute also validate the input via JS to make sure expected input is entered by user.
TypeScript compiler settings enforce strict mode (strict: true, noImplicitAny: true) with zero explicit any type usage.
Complex type models use discriminated unions and type guards over unsafe type assertions (as unknown as T).
